mapper.select: select IFID ,IF_NM from INTERFACEINFO where DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT RULEID ,RULE_NM ,RULEALIAS_NM ,RULE_DESC ,RULERETURN_TYPE ,RULESORT_CD ,RULEUSAGE_CD ,ALLRETURN_YN ,USE_YN ,RULE_VERNO ,ACTIVATE_YN ,(TO_CHAR(ACTIVATE_DATETIME,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')) as ACTIVATE_DATETIME ,(select code_nm from clover_code where code_type='604' and code = RULE_STATE) as RULE_STATE ,(TO_CHAR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')) as DEPLOY_DATETIME ,(select user_nm from clover_user where user_id = DEPLOY_USERID) as DEPLOY_USERID ,IFID ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,(select user_nm from clover_user where user_id = UPDATE_USERID) as UPDATE_USERID ,(SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2) )as UPDATE_DATETIME ,CASE WHEN RULE_STATE = '3' AND RULE_VERNO < 1 THEN 'N' WHEN RULE_STATE = '3' AND RULE_VERNO - TRUNC(RULE_VERNO) > 0 THEN 'U' WHEN RULE_APPLY_YN = 'Y' AND DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN = 'N' THEN 'C' WHEN RULE_APPLY_YN = 'N' AND DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN = 'Y' THEN 'O' ELSE NULL END as TREE_ICON_TYPE ,RULE_APPLY_YN FROM RULE where 1=1
and IFID = #{value}
and (ruleid like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or rule_nm like '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
and RULE_STATE != 'D' ORDER BY ruleid ASC
SELECT RULE_NM ,RULEID FROM RULE

SELECT RULE_NM ,RULEID ,RULEALIAS_NM ,RULE_DESC ,RULERETURN_TYPE ,(SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2) )as UPDATE_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,RULESORT_CD ,RULEUSAGE_CD ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,ALLRETURN_YN ,USE_YN ,IFID ,RULE_VERNO ,ACTIVATE_YN ,(TO_CHAR(ACTIVATE_DATETIME,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')) as ACTIVATE_DATETIME ,RULE_STATE FROM RULE

SELECT a1.RULEID ,a1.RETURN_ITEMID ,a1.RETURNITEM_NO ,a1.UPDATE_USERID ,(SUBSTR(a1.UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(a1.UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(a1.UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(a1.UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(a1.UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(a1.UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2) )as UPDATE_DATETIME ,b.ITEMID ,b.ITEM_NM ,b.ITEMALIAS_NM ,b.ITEMEXPLAN_DESC ,b.DATATYPE_CD FROM RULERETURNITEM a1, RULEITEM b where a1.RETURN_ITEMID = b.ITEMID and a1.RULEID = #{value}

select i.IF_NM, -- 인터페이스명 r.RULE_VERNO, -- 룰 버전번호 r.RULE_STATE, -- 룰상태 r.RULE_NM, -- 룰명 r.RULE_DESC, -- 룰설명 r.RULESORT_CD, -- 룰 종류 r.RULEUSAGE_CD, -- 룰 구분 r.UPDATE_USERID, -- 수정자명 (SUBSTR(r.UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(r.UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(r.UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(r.UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(r.UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(r.UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2) )as UPDATE_DATETIME, r.RULERETURN_TYPE, -- 리턴 형식 r.ALLRETURN_YN, -- 계속점검여부(만족하는모든리턴항목반환여부) r.ACTIVATE_YN from RULE r ,INTERFACEINFO i where r.IFID = i.IFID and r.RULEID = #{value}

select i.ITEMID, i.ITEM_NM, i.ITEMALIAS_NM, i.ITEMEXPLAN_DESC, i.DATATYPE_CD, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '102' AND CODE = i.DATATYPE_CD) AS DATATYPE_NM, i.UPDATE_USERID, (SUBSTR(i.UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(i.UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(i.UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(i.UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(i.UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(i.UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2) )as UPDATE_DATETIME, i.FIRSTREG_USERID, i.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, i.ITEM_USE_YN, i.DATATYPE_CD from RULERETURNITEM r ,RULEITEM i where r.RETURN_ITEMID = i.ITEMID and r.RULEID = #{value}

select rc.RULEID -- 룰아이디 ,rcr.return_itemid ,(select item_nm from ruleitem where itemid=rcr.return_itemid) as item_nm ,rc.RULECONDITIONNO -- 조건식번호 ,rcr.RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC -- 반환값 ,(select datatype_cd from ruleitem where itemid=rcr.return_itemid) as datatype_cd ,rc.CONDITION_INFIX_DESC -- 중위식조건식내용 ,rc.CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC -- 후위식조건식내용 ,rc.CONDITION_DESC -- 조건식설명 from RULE r, RULECONDITION rc, RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM rcr where rc.RULEID = r.RULEID and rcr.RULEID = rc.RULEID and rcr.RULEID = r.RULEID and rcr.RULECONDITIONNO = rc.RULECONDITIONNO and rc.RULEID=#{ruleid} order by rc.RULECONDITIONNO, rcr.RETURN_ITEMID
select RULECONDITIONNO ,CONDITION_INFIX_DESC ,CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC from RULECONDITION where RULEID = #{value} order by RULECONDITIONNO
SELECT LPAD(TO_CHAR(RULE_MAIN_SEQ.NEXTVAL), 7, '0') FROM dual
SELECT LPAD(TO_CHAR(RULE_SUB_SEQ.NEXTVAL), 7, '0') FROM dual
SELECT RULEID FROM RULE where RULE_NM = #{value} and RULE_APPLY_YN = 'Y'
SELECT RULEID ,POSTFIXOBJECTNO ,RULECONDITIONNO ,DATATYPE_CD ,OPERATOR_YN ,OBJECT_DATA FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT WHERE RULEID = #{value}
SELECT RETURN_ITEMID ,RULEID ,RULECONDITIONNO ,POSTFIXOBJECTNO ,DATATYPE_CD ,OPERATOR_YN ,OBJECT_DATA FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT WHERE RULEID = #{value}
SELECT count(*) FROM RULERETURNITEM A , RULE B WHERE A.RULEID = B.RULEID AND RULE_NM = #{value}
SELECT DATATYPE_CD FROM RULERETURNITEM A , RULEITEM B , RULE C WHERE A.RETURN_ITEMID = B.ITEMID AND C.RULEID = A.RULEID AND C.RULE_NM = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE RULE SET USE_YN='N' ,RULE_STATE='D' WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid}
mapper.select: SELECT RULEID ,RULE_NM ,RULEALIAS_NM ,RULE_DESC ,RULERETURN_TYPE ,RULESORT_CD ,RULEUSAGE_CD ,ALLRETURN_YN ,USE_YN ,RULE_VERNO ,ACTIVATE_YN ,ACTIVATE_DATETIME ,RULE_STATE ,DEPLOY_DATETIME ,DEPLOY_USERID ,IFID ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME ,RULE_APPLY_YN ,DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN FROM RULE where RULEID = #{value}

SELECT RULEID ,RULE_NM ,RULEALIAS_NM ,RULE_DESC ,RULERETURN_TYPE ,RULESORT_CD ,RULEUSAGE_CD ,ALLRETURN_YN ,USE_YN ,RULE_VERNO ,ACTIVATE_YN ,(TO_CHAR(ACTIVATE_DATETIME,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')) as ACTIVATE_DATETIME ,(select code_nm from clover_code where code_type='604' and code = RULE_STATE) as RULE_STATE ,(TO_CHAR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')) as DEPLOY_DATETIME ,(select user_nm from clover_user where user_id = DEPLOY_USERID) as DEPLOY_USERID ,IFID ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME ,(select user_nm from clover_user where user_id = UPDATE_USERID) as UPDATE_USERID ,(SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2) )as UPDATE_DATETIME ,RULE_APPLY_YN ,DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN FROM RULE where RULEID = #{value}
select r.ruleid, r.rule_nm, ri.datatype_cd from rulereturnitem rr, rule r, ruleitem ri where rr.ruleid = r.ruleid and rr.return_itemid = ri.itemid and r.use_yn='Y' and r.ifid = #{value}

SELECT RULEID ,RULE_VERNO ,(select code_nm from clover_code where code_type='604' and code=RULE_STATE) as RULE_STATE ,CURRENT_RULE_APPLY_YN ,DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPLY_YN ,(select user_nm from clover_user where user_id = UPDATE_USERID) as UPDATE_USERID ,(SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2))as UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid} order by HISTORY_NO desc
mapper.update: UPDATE RULE SET RULE_STATE = '4' ,DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN = null where RULEID = #{ruleid}
mapper.select: select RULE_STATE from rule where ruleid = #{value}

select A.RULE_APPLY_YN ,CASE WHEN A.RULE_VERNO - TRUNC(A.RULE_VERNO) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS RULE_MODIFY_YN ,A.DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN ,A.IFID ,A.RULEID ,A.RULE_VERNO ,A.RULE_NM ,(select user_nm from clover_user where user_id = A.UPDATE_USERID) as UPDATE_USERID ,(SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2)) AS UPDATE_DATETIME ,( SELECT D.USER_NM FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY C JOIN CLOVER_USER D ON C.UPDATE_USERID = D.USER_ID WHERE C.RULEID = A.RULEID AND C.RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO AND C.RULE_STATE = 3 AND C.HISTORY_NO = ( SELECT MAX(HISTORY_NO) FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY WHERE RULEID = C.RULEID AND RULE_VERNO = C.RULE_VERNO AND RULE_STATE = C.RULE_STATE ) ) AS DEPLOY_WAIT_USERID ,(SELECT SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 0, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY C WHERE C.RULEID = A.RULEID AND C.RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO AND C.RULE_STATE = 3 AND C.HISTORY_NO = (SELECT MAX(HISTORY_NO)FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY WHERE RULEID = C.RULEID AND RULE_VERNO = C.RULE_VERNO AND RULE_STATE = C.RULE_STATE ))AS DEPLOY_WAIT_DATETIME ,( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ITEMID) FROM ( SELECT F.RULEID, F.RETURN_ITEMID AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM F UNION ALL SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = 3 UNION ALL SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = 3 ) D WHERE D.RULEID = A.RULEID ) AS USED_ITEM_CNT
,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUB_RULEID) FROM ( SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 3, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 3) AS SUB_RULEID FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = 4 UNION ALL SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 3) AS SUB_RULEID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = 4 ) WHERE RULEID = A.RULEID ) AS USED_RULE_CNT ,(SELECT MAX((SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME,13,2)) ) AS DEPLOY_DATETIME FROM rule_deploy D WHERE D.RULEID = A.RULEID) AS RECENT_DEPLOY_DATE from rule A RIGHT OUTER JOIN RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM B ON A.RULEID = B.RULEID where A.RULE_STATE = '3' GROUP BY A.RULE_APPLY_YN, CASE WHEN A.RULE_VERNO - TRUNC(A.RULE_VERNO) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, A.DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN, A.IFID, A.RULEID, A.RULE_VERNO, A.RULE_NM, A.UPDATE_USERID, A.UPDATE_DATETIME

SELECT DISTINCT '반환항목' AS USE_GUBUN, A.RETURN_ITEMID AS ITEMID, B.ITEM_NM FROM RULERETURNITEM A INNER JOIN RULEITEM B ON A.RETURN_ITEMID = B.ITEMID WHERE RULEID = #{value} UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT '조건식' AS USE_GUBUN, SUBSTR(A.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(A.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID, B.ITEM_NM FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT A INNER JOIN RULEITEM B ON SUBSTR(A.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(A.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) = B.ITEMID WHERE A.DATATYPE_CD = 3 AND RULEID = #{value} UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT '반환값' AS USE_GUBUN, SUBSTR(A.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(A.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID, B.ITEM_NM FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT A INNER JOIN RULEITEM B ON SUBSTR(A.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(A.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) = B.ITEMID WHERE A.DATATYPE_CD = 3 AND RULEID = #{value}

SELECT MAX((SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME,13,2))) AS DEPLOY_DATETIME FROM rule_deploy

select (SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME,13,2) )as DEPLOY_DATETIME , A.BEFORE_DEPLOY_APPLY_YN , A.AFTER_DEPLOY_APPLY_YN , A.RULE_UPDATE_YN , B.IFID , B.RULEID , B.RULE_NM , U.USER_NM as DEPLOY_USERID ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RULE_LOG WHERE RULE_ID = A.RULEID AND RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(LOG_START_TIME, 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AS RULE_CALL_D3 ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RULE_LOG WHERE RULE_ID = A.RULEID AND RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO AND INSPECTION_YN = 'Y' AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(LOG_START_TIME, 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') >= TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AS RULE_CHECK_D3
,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ITEMID) FROM ( SELECT F.RULEID, F.RETURN_ITEMID AS ITEMID, F.RULE_VERNO FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM_HIST F UNION ALL SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID , F.RULE_VERNO FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT_HI F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = 3 UNION ALL SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID , F.RULE_VERNO FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOB_HI F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = 3 ) D WHERE D.RULEID = A.RULEID AND D.RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO ) AS USED_ITEM_CNT
,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUB_RULEID) FROM ( SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 3, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 3) AS SUB_RULEID, F.RULE_vERNO FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT_HI F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = 4 UNION ALL SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 3) AS SUB_RULEID, F.RULE_vERNO FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOB_HI F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = 4 ) D WHERE D.RULEID = A.RULEID AND D.RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO ) AS USED_RULE_CNT
, A.RULE_VERNO from RULE_DEPLOY A INNER JOIN RULE B ON A.RULEID = B.RULEID INNER JOIN INTERFACEINFO INT ON B.IFID = INT.IFID INNER JOIN CLOVER_USER U ON A.REG_USERID = U.USER_ID
ORDER BY A.DEPLOY_DATETIME DESC
